_comment: Dashboard periods (Vesa, 2026-11-19). Checked by TestPeriodFixture (Go) and make ui-time-range-check (ui/src/lib/timeRange.ts), so the CLI and the UI agree. presets: what the picker offers. canonical: what a saved default or a ?<name>.rel= value means now. defaults: the period a time_range control with no default takes from the time column (outer SELECT list or GROUP BY item) of its datasets' SQL.

defaults.name: daily rollup table, date cast
sqls: SELECT event_date, SUM(n) FROM gold.rollup_page_views_daily WHERE event_date >= CAST(substr({{period.start}}, 1, 10) AS DATE) GROUP BY 1

defaults.name: hourly table
sqls: SELECT event_hour, SUM(n) FROM gold.traffic_hourly WHERE event_hour >= {{period.start}} GROUP BY 1

defaults.name: minute truncation
sqls: SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS m, COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE ts BETWEEN {{tr.start}} AND {{tr.end}} GROUP BY 1

defaults.name: monthly truncation
sqls: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', trip_date) AS m, SUM(fare) FROM trips WHERE trip_date >= {{tr.start}} GROUP BY 1

defaults.name: hourly and daily datasets: the longer period, so the daily chart is not one bar
sqls: SELECT event_hour, n FROM t_hourly WHERE event_hour >= {{period.start}}
SELECT event_date, n FROM t_daily WHERE event_date >= {{period.start}}

defaults.name: only datasets that use the control count
sqls: SELECT event_hour, n FROM t_hourly WHERE event_hour >= {{period.start}}

defaults.name: nothing to go by
sqls: SELECT ts, n FROM events WHERE ts >= {{period.start}}

defaults.name: current_date in a filter is not a time column
sqls: SELECT event_hour, n FROM t WHERE event_hour >= {{period.start}}
SELECT page, COUNT(*) AS n FROM pv WHERE event_ts >= current_date AND event_ts >= {{period.start}} GROUP BY page

defaults.name: an hour(ts) breakdown is not hourly data
sqls: SELECT hour(ts) AS h, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE ts >= {{period.start}} GROUP BY hour(ts)

defaults.name: a month(ts) breakdown is not monthly data
sqls: SELECT event_hour, n FROM t WHERE event_hour >= {{period.start}}
SELECT month(ts) AS m, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE ts >= {{period.start}} GROUP BY month(ts)

defaults.name: a table name says nothing
sqls: SELECT ts, n FROM gold.rollup_hourly WHERE ts >= {{period.start}}

defaults.name: the outer SELECT counts, not a CTE's
sqls: WITH d AS (SELECT event_hour, n FROM t WHERE event_hour >= {{period.start}}) SELECT CAST(event_hour AS DATE) AS day, SUM(n) AS n FROM d GROUP BY 1

defaults.name: a column named in GROUP BY
sqls: SELECT SUM(n) AS n FROM t WHERE ts >= {{period.start}} GROUP BY t.event_hour

defaults.name: a string literal is not an item
sqls: SELECT 'event_hour, x' AS label, ts, n FROM t WHERE ts >= {{period.start}}
